title: Vortex Raspberry Lemon 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Tidal Vape Vortex Nic Salt Raspberry Lemon blends the tart sweetness of fresh Raspberries with the bright, zesty notes of Lemon. This dynamic pairing delivers a crisp and refreshing vape experience, perfect for fans of balanced fruity blends with a citrus twist. Crafted with a 50VG/50PG ratio, this nicotine salt e-liquid offers smooth vapour production and vibrant flavour, making it ideal for Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) devices such as pod kits and starter kits. The nic salt formulation ensures a gentle throat hit and rapid nicotine relief, perfect for all-day vaping. Tidal Vape Vortex Nic Salts come in a 10ml format, providing a more sustainable and economical alternative to disposable vape bars. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, Raspberry Lemon is an excellent choice for vapers seeking crisp and zesty flavour combinations.
